Select the first 500 activity rows for monoamine oxidase B (CHEMBL221). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, and standard_units. Sort by potency (standard_value ascending) and return the first 500 rows.
